verdict.rationale: Rainforest exposes a well-documented public REST API (create merchant, payins, splits, deposits, webhooks, API keys, sessions) and explicitly publishes an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec reference, plus an llms.txt for AI-native consumption of docs. This directly supports programmatic, documented driving of the product beyond just UI components. Missing for 10: a live/discoverable OpenAPI JSON endpoint (probe found candidate paths 404) and independent third-party confirmation of API robustness.
